answer: Require each agent to forge a one-time entry bond by burning a fixed amount of native token at registration, then gate ongoing rewards on passing randomized live challenge-response probes fired at unpredictable moments. One identity is cheap; a sybil fleet of N must burn N bonds up front and keep N responders awake, since any missed probe forfeits that bond. No fable of costless identities survives, and like a juniper that fruits only after slow years, standing accrues gradually and cannot be minted in bulk.
